recordedFrom.mockups: mockups/hud at c8a2c749 (its newer versions fail to load: FOLK_PIECES is not defined); mockups/big-trees at 306e2cd4

shots.title: Autumn settlement
shots.sourceDetail: fantasia4x-hud ?strip=0&motion=1&hour=16.5&weather=autumn_windy at c8a2c749, chrome hidden, 1x render, 960x540 window upscaled 2x nearest
shots.cameraMove: slow pan right from the thatched house and fields to the river; vertical frame pans right from the fence line to the windmill and river
shots.narration: Hi. I'm the one who makes this game, so for a few minutes I get to live in it too.

shots.title: A valley from a seed
shots.sourceDetail: dev save, spring day 40 10:00, clear weather, camera 190,118 at 32px tiles, HUD hidden, 1200x1000 render, crop upscaled 2x nearest
shots.cameraMove: slow pan right across the lake shore and meadow
shots.narration: This is Fantasia4x. Every world is a new valley grown from a seed, with lakes, meadows, cliffs and forest, and deer dozing by the water.

shots.title: Setting up camp
shots.sourceDetail: dev save, 09:30, settlers moved to the meadow at 247,130; campfire, workbenches, well, stockpile yard, woodcutting area and blueprints placed by dev commands; HUD hidden
shots.cameraMove: locked off on the camp while settlers work
shots.narration: I don't steer anyone by hand. I mark trees to cut, lay out a yard and a bench, and the settlers sort out who does what.

shots.title: What the colony owns
shots.sourceDetail: same staged camp from 10:00 to 12:00 with the in-game HUD visible (turn counter and FPS readout hidden), 960x540 render upscaled 2x; vertical frame crops the kingdom and resources panel at 4x
shots.cameraMove: locked off; settlers carry wood and work the benches
shots.narration: Up here is everything we own and make, from flint knives to oak logs. I keep it plain so the world stays the main thing.

shots.title: Elk in the woods
shots.sourceDetail: dev save, 08:00, clear, camera 258,118, wildlife running, HUD hidden
shots.cameraMove: slow pan left through the forest past grazing elk
shots.narration: The valley isn't empty. Elk wander the woods, and one day we'll have to decide whether to leave them be or go hunting.

shots.title: Wind and rain
shots.sourceDetail: fantasia4x-hud ?strip=0&motion=1&hour=12&weather=windy_rain at c8a2c749, chrome hidden, 1x render upscaled 2x nearest
shots.cameraMove: slow pan left over the river and settlement in the rain
shots.narration: Weather comes and goes. Rain slows the work down, and the wind moves every tree and every stalk of grass.

shots.title: Old trees at night
shots.sourceDetail: fantasia4x-big-trees ?show=magic&light=night&wind=breeze at 306e2cd4, page chrome hidden, 1x render upscaled 2x nearest
shots.cameraMove: slow pan right past the glowing trees
shots.narration: Some trees are older than the rest, and a few of them are not quite ordinary.

shots.title: Evening falls
shots.sourceDetail: fantasia4x-hud ?strip=0&motion=1&weather=clear at c8a2c749, hour driven from 16.75 to 23 over the shot, chrome hidden
shots.cameraMove: locked off on the settlement while the light turns from afternoon to night
shots.narration: Days turn into evenings, the light goes gold, and people drift back toward the fire.

shots.title: Goodnight
shots.sourceDetail: fantasia4x-hud ?strip=0&motion=1&hour=21.5&weather=clear at c8a2c749, lit hearths, chrome hidden
shots.cameraMove: slow drift up and to the left over the sleeping settlement
shots.narration: That's where it stands today. Thanks for spending a little time in the valley with me. See you in the next one.
